name: since
label: Since Date
help: Only retrieve messages at or after this date (ISO 8601 format). If empty, all captured messages are returned. Message times are whole minutes.

name: type
label: Interface Type
help: Filter messages by inbox type. If empty, both standard and Sales Navigator messages are returned.

name: threadId
label: Thread ID
help: Restrict the result to a single conversation thread

name: personUrl
label: Person URL
help: Return the whole known conversation with this person instead of the whole inbox, including history loaded by Sync Conversation; the output then also has Threads. A hashed URL always matches; a public URL matches only once Linked API knows it.
